:::{#exr-derive-bernoulli-score}
#### Score function of a Bernoulli variable

Let $X \sim \Ber(\prob)$ have observed value $x \in \cb{0, 1}$.

Derive the [score](#def-score) of $x$.
In other words, differentiate the [log-likelihood](#def-loglik) of $x$
with respect to the [event](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-event) [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) parameter $\prob$,
starting from the log-likelihood in terms of the [log-odds](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-odds) $\logodds \eqdef \logit(\prob)$ in @cor-bernoulli-loglik-contribution-logodds.

:::
